dreamteamer.title: Metrics
dreamteamer.description: `metrics`: one named measure a workspace watches — agent hours per project, open tasks per person, sessions per week — with its unit, the record it is scoped to, its target and the dated readings that make its series, the latest copied into `current` and `as_of`. Depends on `users` (a measure may be scoped to a person); peers `projects`.
